prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE isolated production reference image for image-to-3D reconstruction, square composition, PURE WHITE background (#FFFFFF).
Reference image 1 is the approved painterly low-poly asset style guide. Reference image 2 is the approved gameplay scale/colour context ONLY. Extract the named asset and faithfully preserve its identity; do not include any other objects from those references.
ONE SINGLE OBJECT only, centred and entirely visible with comfortable white margin, neutral three-quarter front view from a slightly elevated camera. Absolutely no label, text, watermark, border, base, pedestal, ground plane, terrain, plants, cast shadow, drop shadow, ambient background wash, glow cloud, motion trail or decorative debris. Do not paint other views or a sheet. White pixels around all silhouette edges. This image will become geometry, so every visible item must actually belong to the requested object.
Art: clean readable low-poly 3D geometry with BROAD VISIBLY HAND-PAINTED gouache albedo strokes, simplified painted shadow/highlight shapes and restrained warm/cool variation. Not smooth plastic, photo-PBR detail, messy flat 2D illustration or a noise overlay. Match the source guide's silhouette, palette, level of detail and charming proportions. Neutral soft light, no harsh baked directional black shadow. Painterly midtones clearly visible at game scale.
SUBJECT: ONE amber straw hat only. Exaggerated broad low-poly brim, rounded blocky short crown, dark navy ribbon band. Broad painted golden ochre gouache strokes. Clearly hollow opening under hat for fitting to farmer's head; camera remains single front three-quarter, not a turnaround. NO head, face, hair, person, mannequin or hatstand.
review: Approved: one broad amber hat with navy band, visible hollow underside, broad golden painterly strokes. No head, stand or extra pieces.
